description: This PHP source file defines the I18NTranslationValidationAPI class, a REST API endpoint for validating internationalization (i18n) translation strings within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes method implementations for handling GET requests to validate translation strings based on provided ID and translation content, along with validation rules and metadata annotations.
